recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Do not remove the example coded outcome binding or duplicate the text guidance elsewhere; future Procedure.outcome changes should be evaluated through the later Procedure outcome issue family.
issue_request: FHIR-7125 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 Procedure. The issue objected to making Procedure.outcome hard coded outcomes; the final resolution kept the coded element but required a usage note that text-only outcomes can be recorded in CodeableConcept.text and clarified that Procedure.outcome is not a replacement for a full diagnostic report section associated with the procedure.
initial_application: Historical commit 512b2462e336c8a6425e2f3dc1a8590403e6e39b, whose message includes #7125, added the Procedure.outcome usage note to the old Procedure spreadsheet source: if outcome contains narrative text only, it can be captured using CodeableConcept.text.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini. The current source has been refactored from the old spreadsheet to source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml. Later Applied issue FHIR-40516 changed Procedure.outcome to 0..* CodeableReference(Observation) while retaining the concept/text path and example binding, and later Applied issue FHIR-47823 added ventilator-setting Observation guidance. These later same-element decisions refine Procedure.outcome but do not reverse FHIR-7125.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current Procedure.outcome comment explicitly permits text-only outcome narrative via CodeableConcept.text, the procedure-outcome binding is example strength, and full reports are represented separately through Procedure.report references.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue changed Procedure.outcome to 0..* CodeableReference(Observation) while retaining the simple concept/text branch and example binding; it is already represented on the combined branch by commit e136f71619e8f31105962f11d15bab86e71b2920.
Later Applied issue appended ventilator-setting Observation guidance to the same Procedure.outcome comment, consistent with retaining Procedure.outcome and using references for richer outcomes.
